# Flags the binary accepts that the Command Explorer does not list.
#
# A budget, not a permission: this file may shrink and must never grow.
# TestEveryFlagIsDocumented fails on a flag that is missing and not listed
# here, and on a line here whose flag is now documented, so the list cannot
# be padded and cannot go stale.
#
# To clear one: add it to that command's flags array in
# docs/config/cli-commands.ts and delete its line below. The Command
# Explorer renders that config and both search indexes read it, so an
# undocumented flag is also an unfindable one.
